depiction.primary_object: outlined heart symbol with open lower-right edge
modifiers: horizontal minus sign at bottom right
depiction.composition: single outlined object with a corner badge modifier

readings.meaning: remove from favorites, wishlist, or saved likes
unlike, unfollow, or clear liked items
lower heart rate or reduce cardiovascular risk
cancel charity donation or end sponsorship

ambiguity: At very small sizes the minus sign can blend into the heart outline or be misread as a plain heart or a heart with a plus sign.
task_intents: remove old songs from liked playlist
lower resting heart rate through cardio

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a heart with a minus sign, standard UI iconography for removing items from favorites, wishlists, or liked collections. While somewhat niche as a to-do item, people regularly jot down tasks to prune wishlists, registries, saved house listings, or liked playlists, and the minus modifier distinguishes it well from a plain heart or heart-plus.
